First off, THANK YOU for putting this clearly.  It's much easier to have disccusions about.

> Asset.Manufacturer       -> Vendor

Doesn't look correct to me.  Manufacturer should map to Manufacturer, right?

Thanks for the feedback. Assembly.v1_0_0 schema defines
"Producer" for the manufacturer.
DMTF LongDescription: "shall be equal to the
Manufacturer field value in a PLDM FRU structure".
Changed mapping to Asset.Manufacturer -> Producer in PS2.

See PS2:
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/88571/1..2/redfish-core/lib/assembly.hpp#159
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/88571/1..2/docs/Redfish.md#498

Oh Redfish. 
We sure  Asset.Manufacturer (PDI) -> Producer would always be true ?

After surveying how Decorator.Asset.Manufacturer is consumed across
bmcweb and cross-checking the DMTF Assembly schema and the PDI
definition, I believe this mapping is correct and always holds.

OpenBMC PDI, xyz.openbmc_project.Inventory.Decorator.Asset.Manufacturer:
  "The item manufacturer."
https://github.com/openbmc/phosphor-dbus-interfaces/blob/master/yaml/xyz/openbmc_project/Inventory/Decorator/Asset.interface.yaml#L12-L15

DMTF Assembly schema, Producer:
  "This property shall contain the name of the company that produced or
   manufactured the assembly. This value shall be equal to the
   'Manufacturer' field value in a PLDM FRU structure, if applicable,
   for the assembly."
https://redfish.dmtf.org/schemas/v1/Assembly_v1.xml

PDI Manufacturer is the item manufacturer, and Assembly Producer is
defined to equal that same manufacturer value, so Asset.Manufacturer ->
Producer is what the schema prescribes.

Across bmcweb every resource that exposes a manufacturer maps
Decorator.Asset.Manufacturer to whatever field its schema defines for
the maker (memory, processor, managers, ... -> "Manufacturer").
Assembly is the only one whose schema has no "Manufacturer" property --
it offers only Producer and Vendor -- so Producer is the equivalent
target here.

Vendor would be the wrong target -- the schema binds it to a different
field:
  "...the company that provides the final product that includes this
   assembly. This value shall be equal to the 'Vendor' field value in a
   PLDM FRU structure, if applicable, for the assembly."
i.e. the reseller/integrator, not the maker. Decorator.Asset exposes no
Vendor (or Producer) property anyway, so Producer is the only correct
mapping.

Please let me know if I have this wrong -- happy to adjust. Thanks for help.
